rca_inverse_correlation: The brief assumed that BI's focus on Rupiah stability and encouraging foreign portfolio inflow would lead to a bullish IHSG. However, despite the Rupiah strengthening by -0.211% and actual foreign accumulation of Rp 829,70 Miliar, the IHSG closed bearish by -0.75%.
lessons: Ketika BI mempertahankan BI-Rate dan fokus pada stabilitas Rupiah serta aliran portofolio asing (diprediksi bullish), tetapi sentimen valuasi IHSG (rasio P/E) membayangi pasar, maka IHSG dapat ditutup bearish sebesar -0.75%.

Ketika aliran dana asing diprediksi stagnan/sideways, tetapi terjadi akumulasi asing yang signifikan (net buy Rp 829,70 Miliar) disertai penguatan Rupiah, maka IHSG dapat ditutup bearish sebesar -0.75%.
summary: The morning brief predicted a bullish IHSG and stagnant foreign flow, but the market closed bearish by 0.75% with significant foreign accumulation, while most predicted bullish sectors actually declined.
